changes: No substantive changes. Added a note on the uncertain LS epoch and on the illegible line.

notes: The cataloguer put 'raghu' in brackets in the scribe's name, which suggests the letters are unclear or restored. The year is computed as LS 393 + 1119 = 1512 CE. The epoch of the Lakṣmaṇa Saṃvat is disputed, so the year could be off by a few years; a check against the weekday (Saturday, Mārgaśīrṣa śukla 14) could settle it. After the colophon comes a short ritual passage (śrīvastra(sekha)kaṃ satkārapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ), and according to the cataloguer's footnote one further line is illegible. The place Poāvīgrāma has not been identified; it is presumably in Mithilā.
